name: Pack Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Hunting

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the lay of the land power of the Hunting domain.

Pack Leader (Su)

Any animal you summon, charm dominate or have as an animal companion gains a + 1 morale bonus on saves as long as they can see or hear you. this bonus increases by 1 for every 5 class levels you possess. Additionally, you may cast and prepare summon nature’s ally instead of summon monster.

Domain Spells

1st–call animal, 3rd–stench of prey, 5th-release the hounds, 7th–summon nature’s ally VII
